description: Na₄Sc₃In(SiO₃)₈ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.95 Å. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.22 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.23 Å. In the third Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.23 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.25 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InO₆ octahedra, corners with two ScO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.67 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InO₆ octahedra, corners with two ScO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-58°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one InO₆ octahedra, corners with two ScO₆ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 32-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one In, and one Si atom.
